# Bolivia in 11 Days: Titicaca, La Paz, Uyuni and Torotoro

This itinerary links cities, high-altitude lakes, archaeological sites, the Uyuni Salt Flat, colourful lagoons and Torotoro National Park. Over 11 days, you'll visit Santa Cruz, see Tiwanaku and Lake Titicaca, explore La Paz, cross the Uyuni Salt Flat and reach the Eduardo Avaroa Reserve before travelling to Cochabamba and Torotoro.

**Duration:** 11 days / 10 nights  
**Route:** Santa Cruz - Titicaca - La Paz - Cochabamba - Uyuni

The route takes you through some of Bolivia's most varied landscapes. In the Valley of the Moon, you'll see unusual rock formations. Volcanoes rise above the high plateaus, and giant cacti grow on Incahuasi Island amid the white salt flats. Uyuni is dazzling white in the sun and turns into an immense mirror after rain. At Tiwanaku, you'll learn about one of South America's most important ancient civilisations. Lake Titicaca adds islands, sacred sites and Andean traditions to the trip, and Torotoro rounds it off with caves, canyons, waterfalls and dinosaur footprints.
